ProjectAdapterOutput.description: One adapter of the bound config.

ProjectDiagnosticsOutput.description: The compile's diagnostics, counted. All zero before the first compile.

has_errors.description: `true` when the compile reported an error-severity diagnostic — and also when the last compile produced no result at all (`compile_error` on the project), with `total` and `warnings` at zero: "did not compile" is never "no errors" (#1823).

ProjectPipelineOutput.description: One pipeline of the bound config.

ProjectRunOutput.description: The newest run, as the dashboard summarised it.

description:
The project a sidecar serves, for `GET /api/v1/project`: what the server-rendered dashboard at `/` used to show, as a typed payload.

Server-only, no CLI twin. Bounded by construction: names of pipelines and adapters (a handful), counts for models and diagnostics, and the one newest run. The model names are on `GET /api/v1/models` and the DAG.

compile_error.description: Why the last compile produced no result, when it did not: the models could not be read, a model failed to load, the compile task panicked. While this stands `models_compiled` is absent and `diagnostics.has_errors` is `true`, whatever an earlier compile found: a project whose models cannot be compiled is not a clean project, and counts from a compile that no longer describes it are not shown beside its failure (#1823). Absent when the last compile produced a result, and before the first compile finishes.

config_error.description: Why the config could not be loaded, when it could not. The lists below are then empty.

config_path.description: The bound config's path; `null` when the sidecar has none.

last_run.description: The newest run in the state store the server resolved; `null` when none was recorded.

models_compiled.description: Models in the in-memory compile result. Absent (not `null`) before the first compile finishes and while `compile_error` stands; absent with no `compile_error` is the pending state, which the browser UI shows as pending rather than as zero diagnostics.

name.description: The directory the bound `rocky.toml` lives in, or `rocky` when no config is bound.
